rule_group_description: Blocks unsanctioned generative-AI desktop apps, MCP servers, and agent runtimes on hosts assigned to the AI-Banned host group. Authored by Project Eyas via extras_shadow_ai_adopt_prevention. Edit in Falcon Console if you need to tune; the adoption tool is idempotent and will not overwrite operator changes once the rule already exists by name.

windows.name: ShadowAI: Cursor (agentic IDE)
windows.description: Blocks Cursor.exe (Anysphere / Cursor) — agentic IDE with built-in MCP client and hosted agent loop. Per-user Squirrel install at %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\cursor.

windows.name: ShadowAI: Ollama (local-inference runtime)
windows.description: Blocks Ollama daemon + tray + helper images. Local LLM runtime exposing an OpenAI-compatible REST API on 11434; main local-inference data-egress surface. Both `ollama.exe` and `ollama app.exe` (tray) are matched.

windows.name: ShadowAI: LM Studio (local-inference desktop)
windows.description: Blocks LM Studio desktop. Squirrel-installed Electron app that exposes an OpenAI-compatible local server on 1234 by default.

windows.name: ShadowAI: Claude Desktop (Anthropic, MCP host)
windows.description: Blocks Claude Desktop. The MCP-host capability (claude_desktop_config.json registers MCP servers that inherit user privileges) is the load-bearing reason — preserving Claude itself without MCP wiring is not a posture the app supports.

windows.name: ShadowAI: Claude Desktop installer (Squirrel)
windows.description: Blocks Anthropic's Claude-Setup.exe Squirrel installer. Pairs with the post-install Claude.exe rule so re-installs after Ban+Clean fail at the installer, not just the launch step.

windows.name: ShadowAI: Cursor installer (Squirrel)
windows.description: Blocks Cursor-Setup-X.Y.Z-{x64,arm64}.exe (Anysphere). Same reasoning as the Claude Desktop installer — IOA at launch is necessary but not sufficient against re-install.

windows.name: ShadowAI: LM Studio installer
windows.description: Blocks LM-Studio-X.Y.Z-Setup.exe / LM-Studio-Setup.exe. NSIS-shaped installer; covers both versioned and bare names.

windows.name: ShadowAI: Ollama installer
windows.description: Blocks OllamaSetup.exe (the only installer name Ollama ships). Pairs with the ollama.exe / ollama-app.exe runtime rules.

windows.name: ShadowAI: ComfyUI (local image/video generation)
windows.description: Blocks python.exe / pythonw.exe whose CommandLine references ComfyUI's main.py or server.py. ComfyUI is not a packaged installer — image-only rules don't apply; cmdline match is the only reliable signal.

windows.name: ShadowAI: MCP server (npm @modelcontextprotocol)
windows.description: Blocks node.exe / npx.exe spawning an @modelcontextprotocol/* package. This is the canonical npm-distributed MCP server shape; the agent gets whatever capabilities the server exposes (filesystem, github, shell) under the user's identity.

windows.name: ShadowAI: MCP server (uvx Python launcher)
windows.description: Blocks uvx.exe spawning an mcp-* / awslabs.mcp-* / @org/mcp-* package. uvx is the de-facto Python MCP-server launcher; the package-name pattern is stable across MCP server publishers.

windows.name: ShadowAI: MCP server (python -m mcp_server / mcp-server-*)
windows.description: Blocks python.exe -m mcp_server* / mcp-server-* invocations (self-hosted MCP servers run directly via the python module system rather than via uvx).

windows.name: ShadowAI: Aider (agentic coding loop)
windows.description: Blocks the Aider agentic-coding REPL. Aider runs as `python -m aider` or via the `aider` console_script; the cmdline match covers both shapes.

windows.name: ShadowAI: DeepSeek model load (any runtime)
windows.description: Blocks any process whose CommandLine references a DeepSeek model name (deepseek-r1 / deepseek-v3 / deepseek-coder / deepseek-chat / deepseek-llm / deepseek-moe). Catches the case where Ollama / LM Studio / llama.cpp themselves are sanctioned but loading a DeepSeek-family weight isn't. DeepSeek is hosted in China and the company's published policy explicitly states user prompts are retained for training; even local-weight inference of these models is frequently policy-disallowed in regulated environments. Image is unrestricted on purpose — runs against any process loading the model name.

windows.name: ShadowAI: Open Interpreter (local agent loop)
windows.description: Blocks Open Interpreter. Runs a local LLM-driven shell; highest-blast-radius agentic framework currently in the catalog because it directly executes shell commands.

mac.name: ShadowAI: Cursor (agentic IDE) — macOS
mac.description: Blocks /Applications/Cursor.app launches on macOS. Cursor for Mac is distributed as a .dmg-bundled .app; the post-install binary lives at <prefix>/Cursor.app/Contents/MacOS/Cursor.

mac.name: ShadowAI: Ollama (local-inference runtime) — macOS
mac.description: Blocks Ollama on macOS — both the bundled tray app at /Applications/Ollama.app and the daemon binary installed at /usr/local/bin/ollama or /opt/homebrew/bin/ollama (Homebrew Apple Silicon prefix). Same data-egress concern as Windows: exposes a local OpenAI-compatible REST API on 11434.

mac.name: ShadowAI: LM Studio (local-inference desktop) — macOS
mac.description: Blocks LM Studio.app launches on macOS. Bundle path is /Applications/LM Studio.app/Contents/MacOS/LM Studio.

mac.name: ShadowAI: Claude Desktop (Anthropic, MCP host) — macOS
mac.description: Blocks Claude.app on macOS. Same MCP-host capability concern as the Windows rule — claude_desktop_config.json registers MCP servers under user privileges. macOS bundle path is <prefix>/Claude.app/Contents/MacOS/Claude.

mac.name: ShadowAI: ComfyUI (local image/video generation) — macOS
mac.description: Blocks python3 / python launches whose CommandLine references ComfyUI's main.py or server.py. Same shape as the Windows rule — image-only doesn't apply (Python is the real runtime); cmdline is the only reliable signal.

mac.name: ShadowAI: MCP server (npm @modelcontextprotocol) — macOS
mac.description: Blocks node / npx spawning an @modelcontextprotocol/* package on macOS. Standard install paths covered: Homebrew (/opt/homebrew, /usr/local), nvm-managed (~/.nvm/versions/), and Volta (~/.volta/bin). Falcon's macOS Custom IOA regex engine is full-match-anchored implicitly; no trailing `$`.

mac.name: ShadowAI: MCP server (uvx Python launcher) — macOS
mac.description: Blocks uvx spawning an mcp-* / awslabs.mcp-* / @org/mcp-* package on macOS. uvx is typically installed at ~/.cargo/bin/uvx, /opt/homebrew/bin/uvx, or /usr/local/bin/uvx.

mac.name: ShadowAI: MCP server (python module) — macOS
mac.description: Blocks python -m mcp_server* / mcp-server-* invocations on macOS. Self-hosted Python MCP servers run directly via the module system rather than via uvx.

mac.name: ShadowAI: Aider (agentic coding loop) — macOS
mac.description: Blocks the Aider REPL on macOS — `python -m aider` or the `aider` console_script (typically at ~/.local/bin/aider, /opt/homebrew/bin/aider).

mac.name: ShadowAI: DeepSeek model load (any runtime) — macOS
mac.description: Blocks any process whose CommandLine references a DeepSeek model name on macOS. Same rationale as the Windows rule — DeepSeek's hosted policy retains user prompts for training. Image is unrestricted on purpose.

mac.name: ShadowAI: Open Interpreter (local agent loop) — macOS
mac.description: Blocks Open Interpreter on macOS. Same rationale as the Windows rule: highest-blast-radius agentic framework — runs a local LLM-driven shell.

linux.name: ShadowAI: Cursor (agentic IDE) — Linux
linux.description: Blocks Cursor on Linux. Distributed as AppImage (Cursor-X.Y.Z.AppImage) or .deb (/opt/Cursor/cursor, /usr/share/cursor/cursor, /usr/bin/cursor).

linux.name: ShadowAI: Ollama (local-inference runtime) — Linux
linux.description: Blocks Ollama on Linux. The official curl|sh installer drops the binary at /usr/local/bin/ollama or /usr/bin/ollama; AppImage / Snap installs are also possible. Both the daemon and CLI invocations are blocked.

linux.name: ShadowAI: LM Studio (local-inference desktop) — Linux
linux.description: Blocks LM Studio on Linux. Distributed as AppImage (LM-Studio-X.Y.Z.AppImage).

linux.name: ShadowAI: ComfyUI (local image/video generation) — Linux
linux.description: Blocks python3 launches whose CommandLine references ComfyUI's main.py or server.py on Linux. Same shape as Windows / macOS.

linux.name: ShadowAI: MCP server (npm @modelcontextprotocol) — Linux
linux.description: Blocks node / npx spawning an @modelcontextprotocol/* package on Linux. Covers /usr/bin/, /usr/local/bin/, nvm-managed (~/.nvm/versions/), and Volta (~/.volta/bin). Falcon's Linux Custom IOA regex engine is full-match-anchored implicitly; no trailing `$`.

linux.name: ShadowAI: MCP server (uvx Python launcher) — Linux
linux.description: Blocks uvx spawning an mcp-* / awslabs.mcp-* / @org/mcp-* package on Linux. Standard install: ~/.cargo/bin/uvx, /usr/local/bin/uvx.

linux.name: ShadowAI: MCP server (python module) — Linux
linux.description: Blocks python -m mcp_server* / mcp-server-* invocations on Linux.

linux.name: ShadowAI: Aider (agentic coding loop) — Linux
linux.description: Blocks the Aider REPL on Linux — `python -m aider` or the `aider` console_script (typically at ~/.local/bin/aider, /usr/local/bin/aider).

linux.name: ShadowAI: DeepSeek model load (any runtime) — Linux
linux.description: Blocks any process whose CommandLine references a DeepSeek model name on Linux. Same rationale as the Windows rule.

linux.name: ShadowAI: Open Interpreter (local agent loop) — Linux
linux.description: Blocks Open Interpreter on Linux. Same rationale as the Windows rule.
